payload.text: Anything released through Homebrew follows dev, opt, brew as dev, stage, prod (hv, 2026-10-24): the maintainer works in a dev checkout, publishes a working copy to opt to keep the bleeding edge (dev) apart from what works (opt), and the brew formula is the one prod publish. A user installs from brew and seeds projects from the brew install; dev and opt are maintainer-only, named only where a doc speaks to the maintainer of a dev checkout, never as the way a user installs. Applies to devbin, Intent, Utilz and every other formula.
